page.overview:
Who is Baby Tree Trunks?

Baby Tree Trunks is an alternate version of Tree Trunks. She lives in a world where everyone is a baby and was first seen in "The Winter King".

She is a small light green elephant with a very tender face. She is also wearing a pink dress. Very different from her original counterpart, which is an old woman.
